none: PAS NLM-AB6D20: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Nottinghamshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Coin fragment. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), probably a copy of a fallen horseman issue of 355-361, Reece period 18. Obverse description: Bust diademed right with large eye. Reverse description: soldier advancing left spearing fallen horseman. Reverse inscription: [FEL TEMP REPARATIO]. Cliff Reeves kindly examined this coin. Diameter (in excess of): 11.4mm, weight: 0.56gms, die axis: probably 6
